name: EBU STL
summary: Exports subtitles as EBU STL teletext files for broadcast delivery.
description: Adds EBU STL (.stl) to Export as and Save as. Each Line becomes a teletext subtitle of up to 2 rows of 40 characters, at 25 or 30 frames a second, with italics, underline and top or bottom placement. Lines that don't fit are cut, and the export names them.
